messages:
marie (PM): Quick sync — we got a big ask from Acme: they want predictable committed throughput but also room to burst beyond slab without long contract amendments. Thinking of a new 'elastic ceiling' / 'soft slab' add-on. Thoughts?

sam (Sales): +1 from field. Customers hate hard caps cuz they block product experiments. Need a simple escape hatch for contract teams.

aj (Finance): Need a model. If we let bursts above commit, what's our expected revenue leakage vs. increased conversions? Share a sample calc.

nina (Engineer): Implementation-wise we can support a 'ceiling_multiplier' on Dedicated pools and a per-tenant token-bucket for bursts. Latency SLOs may degrade if everyone bursts simultaneously.

lee (Legal): We can add an 'elastic ceiling' clause but need guardrails: defined max multiplier, auto-throttle triggers, and explicit overage billing cadence. Also define audit rights.

rachel (CSE): Also watch telemetry — customers will want visibility per route and per-model. Dashboard widget request noted.

marie (PM): Draft scope proposal in doc: https://redwood.app/drive/elastic-ceiling-proposal (preview). Key options:
- Option A: Pay-per-burst (metered): pay actual tokens at premium rate
- Option B: Ceiling credit pool (prepaid): credits purchased, rollover? no
- Option C: Flexible commit (higher monthly commit w/ lower overage)

sam (Sales): Option B is attractive for renewals. Option A helps small startups.

aj (Finance): Rough calc example:
```:
BaseCommitRevenue = commit_units * price_commit
BurstRevenue = burst_tokens * price_burst
Scenario = +10% conversion vs baseline
```:
We need a model spreadsheet.

nina (Engineer): For Config we propose:
```:
SoftSlab:
  base_quota: 2_000_000
  ceiling_multiplier: 3
  overage_rate_multiplier: 1.8
  monitoring: true
```:

lee (Legal): Also include SLA carveouts: burst windows not counted for latency credit if they exceed 5 consecutive minutes. Add cancellation clause.

marie (PM): Launch criteria suggestion:
- Pilot with 2 customers (mid-enterprise / scale-up)
- Observability: per-route latency & cost breakdown
- Billing model agreed w/ finance/legal

rachel (CSE): I'll scope customer-facing docs + sample contract language.

sam (Sales): Who owns rollout? PM + Sales + Billing + Legal + Eng

marie (PM): I'll own the RFC and pilot plan. Action items:
- @aj create revenue model by EOW
- @nina validate perf risk and queue sizing
- @lee draft contract clause
- @rachel prepare docs for pilot
- @sam propose pilot customers

ops-bot: Reminder — RFC template created: /docs/rfc/elastic-ceiling.md :thumbsup:

aj (Finance): Will share sheet by Friday.

nina (Engineer): Quick Q: do we allow cross-tenant bursting into a shared pool? risky.

marie (PM): Prefer per-tenant first. Shared pool as future enhancement.

sam (Sales): noted. I'll reach out to two customers now.

lee (Legal): ack, starting clause draft.

rachel (CSE): I'll draft the dashboard mockups.

marie (PM): Thanks team — follow-up in weekly pricing sync. :calendar:
